remarks: Opportunity to own a 0.31-acre residential parcel located on Long Ridge Road in Stamford. Situated in an established residential area of North Stamford, this property offers a unique opportunity for buyers, builders, investors, or neighboring property owners. Owner financing is available, offering added flexibility for qualified buyers. Conveniently located with access to Stamford amenities, shopping, dining, recreation, and major commuting routes. Property is located in the RA-2 zoning district. Buyer to perform all due diligence and independently verify potential uses, building requirements, approvals, utilities, wetlands, and zoning compliance with the City of Stamford.
